name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) is the very-next-move pickup rule after a fall, and Response(at_exit, holding_box) is the if-you-reach-the-exit rule that the box is held on that step. Both are hard, with the right argument order and no preference cue. No Existence clause is needed: the task only states conditions, and box_fell and at_exit are conditions, not commanded goals.

texts: Whenever the box falls, the agent's very next step picks the box back up, so the agent holds the box at that next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, the agent must be holding the box at that same step.
